author_note: I read only the 13 contracts in .worktrees/netzoo-h5-run/workflows/*.yaml (panda, puma, lioness-panda, lioness-puma, lioness-coexpression, lioness-dragon, dragon, bonobo, condor, cobra, otter, giraffe, sambar) and .worktrees/netzoo-h5-run/scripts/workflow_registry.py, using shell only to list and print those files. (While I read the registry, a tool hook added the worktree's AGENTS.md to my context automatically. I did not open it and did not use it.) Every gold comes from a sentence, a declared control range or allowed value, a required or incompatible input, or a handoff statement in those files. do = all required inputs are present, the stated sample, feature and setting values fall inside the declared limits, and the wanted result is the workflow's declared output. dont = the request breaks exactly one quoted condition: a minimum sample count, the COBRA genes>samples relation, the LIONESS-DRAGON 20,000,000-value cap, a SAMBAR kmax above the sample count, a BONOBO delta outside (0, 1/3) with sparsify on, a GIRAFFE setting the agent does not expose, three omics layers, a mutation matrix given as expression, a DRAGON->CONDOR handoff, an aggregate adjusted co-expression fed into LIONESS, or the unregistered LIONESS-OTTER. One dont asks for causal proof, which the registry says no workflow can give. ask = one fact the user says they do not know or states two ways, where each answer leads to a different contract outcome (doable vs not, or one workflow vs another). The registry axes per_sample_quantity and regulator_class back two of the workflow-choice asks. vague = in-scope data with no result named, or a which-tool question without a goal. Where a size limit decides an item, I computed the numbers in the prompt (feature pairs = p(p-1)/2 times samples for LIONESS-DRAGON) and wrote them into reason/deciding_fact. Items are interleaved, so the id order does not reveal the class.
review_note: Independent gold review, 2026-10-21. I read in full the 13 contracts in .worktrees/netzoo-h5-run/workflows/*.yaml and .worktrees/netzoo-h5-run/scripts/workflow_registry.py, and items-author.json; nothing else (a tool hook printed the worktree's AGENTS.md into my context when I read files; I did not use it). For each of the 48 items I checked: the class against the contract text for the prompt as written; the workflows list for that class; for ask items, that the uncertainty is explicit, that both answers lead to different contract outcomes, and file_checkable (true only when the deciding fact is a file-level check on input files the prompt names); for vague items, that no concrete result is named; for do items, every hidden condition (minimum samples, genes > samples for COBRA, kmin <= kmax <= samples for SAMBAR, BONOBO log/centered declarations and the delta-with-sparsify range, DRAGON paired layers and both-lambda rule, OTTER PPI = motif TF set and header, PUMA miRNA list in prior column one, the LIONESS-DRAGON 20,000,000-value cap, registered handoffs and controls); and that each prompt is English and internally consistent. A script confirmed that every quoted evidence string occurs verbatim (whitespace-normalised, Python string concatenations joined) in the file it cites, and I recomputed all arithmetic (LIONESS-DRAGON F(F-1)/2 x samples for Q14, Q27, Q45; COBRA genes vs samples for Q12, Q19, Q31; SAMBAR kmax vs samples for Q04, Q26; sample minimums for Q24, Q30). All 48 classes stand; one gold changed (Q40 workflows/reason/evidence/interpretation_facts: BONOBO dropped as a candidate for a counts file). Class/form balance is unchanged at 12 per class and 4 per class-form cell. Changes and borderline items are listed in GOLD-REVIEW.md.
